approved_brand.name: SimpleElm

approved_brand.photography: No photography of people. Abstract 3D renders and generative/AI visuals only: glowing gradient S-mark on a pedestal, neural network node graphs, holographic geometric grids, silhouette-in-portal compositions. Consistent blue-cyan-violet gradient lighting across every image.
approved_brand.iconography: Lucide-style outline icons, 1.75px-2px stroke, rounded joins, no fill except active/selected states. Domain set: home, courses (book), labs (flask), AI playground (brain), learning paths (route), community (users), assistant/help (message-circle).

approved_brand.personality: Friendly, modern, AI-forward, confident but approachable — 'learn deep concepts, simply.' Technical credibility without being cold or corporate.
approved_brand.layout_style: Centered hero with large 3D gradient mark, bento grid of feature tiles, dedicated interactive-learning module (sliders + live chart), mixed asymmetric proof/vision sections, consistent card-with-icon-tile pattern.
approved_brand.hero_style: Centered, product-forward hero: headline + subhead + dual CTA beside a glowing 3D brand mark composition.
approved_brand.cta_tone: ابدأ التعلم الآن / استكشف الكورسات — start learning, explore courses, try the AI playground.

aspect_ratios.portraits: not used — brand uses no human photography

photography_system.color_grading: cool blue-cyan-violet gradient lighting; deep navy shadows in both light and dark contexts; no warm/natural color grading
photography_system.background_style: abstract 3D renders, particle/network fields, geometric grids — never real environments or stock photography
photography_system.portrait_rules: no human portraits or headshots anywhere in the product; all proof/credibility signals use data, logos, or ratings instead

iconography_system.style: Lucide-style outline icons, 1.75px-2px stroke, rounded joins, no fill except active/selected states.
iconography_system.density: one icon per feature tile / nav item; never decorative repeated rows
iconography_system.placement: inline with labels or inside a small rounded icon chip at the start of a card/nav item
iconography_system.domain_rule: home, courses (book-open), labs (flask-conical), AI playground (brain), learning paths (route), community (users), assistant/help (message-circle) — real product-navigation icons only

anti_repetition_rules: no same hero pattern on adjacent public pages
homepage must not use generic centered SaaS hero

component_personality.buttons: specific CTA text, clear primary/secondary hierarchy
component_personality.cards: vary layout by content type; no six equal cards
component_personality.badges: max three badge types per page
component_personality.stats: one featured metric or real table; no fake metric row
component_personality.tables: dense admin utility, restrained borders, no zebra-striping

content_realism.numbers: derive numbers from visible records or page-specific inventory; explain if estimated
content_realism.names: use locale/domain-appropriate names for EdTech; admin records must look operational
content_realism.titles: real page/entity titles from the page map and spec vocabulary, never numbered placeholders
content_realism.testimonials: only with named context and believable outcome; omit if the spec has no testimonial signal
content_realism.metrics_logic: prefer counts from static_content_needed; avoid broad success claims unless sourced
content_realism.name_logic: Arabic-first public names when Arabic/RTL is detected; role-specific admin names

narrative_patterns.assignment_logic: page-purpose aware: home authority, detail methodology, listing comparison, admin operational
anti_repetition_rules: do not repeat Problem-Proof-CTA on every page
detail pages should use evidence and methodology

section_diversity.assignment_logic: content-structure aware: listing/detail/form/admin sections choose different section systems
